how.title: How Parallaxa checks
how.step1: Three AI models from different countries and perceived leanings investigate independently.
how.step2: A published rule combines their verdicts. Disagreements are shown, not hidden.
how.step3: Every source, quote and step is visible, and people review disputed cases.
